## Official Topic

Additional topics in visualization and communication. Project 2 due.

## Problem Focus

What makes a computational result worth believing and worth reading?

Students revise final reports for clarity, reproducibility, interpretation, and responsible documentation of AI assistance.

## In Class

- Improve figures and captions.
- Separate evidence from speculation.
- Audit reproducibility.
- Prepare final project communication.

## AI-Aware Task

Ask an LLM to critique a draft conclusion. Keep only suggestions that are supported by the analysis and revise any vague or exaggerated claims.
